This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of 5 [[nonconvex great rhombicuboctahedron|nonconvex great rhombicuboctahedra]], in the same arrangement (i.e. sharing vertices with) the [[compound of five truncated cubes|compound of 5 truncated cubes]].
